UK Physics & Astronomy Application Information
UK Physics & Astronomy Application Information
(see also FAQ for prospective graduate students)
DEADLINES for Fall Admissions:
Application for admission with financial aid: Jan. 15. Please note: This is the departmental deadline, which is earlier than the Graduate School deadline of April 15.
Application for admission without financial aid: July 19 (domestic applicants) or Feb. 1 (international applicants). The departmental deadline applies here as well. Please ensure all materials are submitted before these dates to meet departmental requirements.
How to apply:
Follow the online application procedure at the UK Graduate School. The direct link to the application page is here. Select the "Create Account" tab to get started. Both DOMESTIC APPLICANTS AND INTERNATIONAL APPLICANTS will have to pay the graduate school fee when they apply, otherwise their application will not be processed.
Application Fees waivers:
The Graduate School does not offer application fees waivers. However the Department of Physics and Astronomy has scholarships which can be used to pay the application fees of a small number of applicants. These scholarships are offered on a competitive basis. If you are interested please write to us.
If you have questions, including about the fees waivers, please email gradapply-pa@uky.edu.
